arm_set.name: v4_run4_four_gate_arms
arm_set.dropped_arms_reason: The ch25 gate criteria name fixed inspection, random views and systematic coverage. Those three are flown. V3_PROTOCOL_CONTROL was an attribution control in run 3 and decides no criterion; attribution is already recorded in run 3, so run 4 spends its budget on fresh paired worlds for the criterion that remained statistically unresolved.
arm_set.reason: Four gate arms on 60 fresh worlds. The sample size is fixed before flight from the run-3 information/energy miss: n=30 yielded a positive point estimate with a CI lower bound just below zero; n=60 is the declared fresh-sample resolution.
decides_criteria: beats fixed views on actual hidden-state reconstruction

run_once: This 60-world sample is read exactly once. If a criterion fails, gate I4 remains FAIL and the result is recorded as such. No extra worlds may be appended after seeing the result.
decision_rule: Unit = one world, paired across arms. PRODUCTION beats a comparator on a metric iff the lower bound of the 95 % paired percentile-bootstrap CI over worlds (4000 resamples, rng seed 20260919) of the benefit (PRODUCTION better = positive) is above 0. Gate I4 passes iff every criterion passes: the closed loop, beats fixed views, beats random views, beats coverage-only on hidden_state_error_improvement, and beats fixed, random AND coverage on info_per_time AND info_per_kj. No numeric margin is invented.
